page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. This instance features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, utilizing a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU hardware.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. Because the instance allocates dedicated physical cores without hyperthreading, it provides predictable, non-shared compute performance. This hardware profile is designed to avoid resource contention, making it highly stable for workloads requiring consistent CPU execution.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high clock speed position this instance as a premium resource for compute-heavy and multi-threaded applications. The lack of bundled local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage options. This server is suited for general-purpose enterprise applications, high-performance web serving, build systems, and compute-intensive workloads that benefit from dedicated physical cores.
